This is a real behavioral regression introduced by the change.

judged_text: The Disqus importer now creates topics via TopicEmbed.import_remote, which accepts no created_at (and the -c category option was deleted from the thor task), so the original thread dates previously passed as created_at: Date.parse(t[:created_at]) are discarded. Every topic imported by 'disqus.thor import' is stamped with the import run's current time instead of its source publish date, destroying the chronological fidelity (latest lists, bump ordering, topic sorting) the prior PostCreator call preserved, and imports can no longer target a category — passing -c now fails as an unknown option and everything lands in uncategorized.

record.issue_text: [BUG] The Disqus importer now creates topics via TopicEmbed.import_remote, which accepts no created_at (and the -c category option was deleted from the thor task), so the original thread dates previously passed as created_at: Date.parse(t[:created_at]) are discarded. Every topic imported by 'disqus.thor import' is stamped with the import run's current time instead of its source publish date, destroying the chronological fidelity (latest lists, bump ordering, topic sorting) the prior PostCreator call preserved, and imports can no longer target a category — passing -c now fails as an unknown option and everything lands in uncategorized.

adjudication.rationale: In `lib/tasks/disqus.thor`, the importer no longer uses `PostCreator.new(... created_at: Date.parse(t[:created_at]), category: category_id)` and instead calls `TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], title: t[:title])`. `TopicEmbed.import_remote`/`.import` create posts via `PostCreator.new(... skip_validations: true, cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html])` without passing `created_at` or `category`, so imported topics/posts will be timestamped at import time and cannot be targeted to a category. Additionally, the Thor `:category` option (`-c`) was removed, so `-c` will now be an unknown option.
